name: polygres
description: Connect to Polygres MCP, set up data pipelines, operate projects, build retrieval, and troubleshoot through supported MCP, dashboard, CLI, SDK, and Runtime API workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and operate Polygres safely
interface.longDescription: Connect to Polygres through MCP, inspect projects and data, choose managed PostgreSQL sync or an adaptive pipeline, configure AI Search and graph retrieval, build applications with the Python SDK, and diagnose failures from public read-only evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Polygres MCP to inspect this project and recommend the next useful setup step.
Use $polygres-data-pipeline to design pgContext RAG and verify it with the SDK.
Use $polygres-troubleshooting to diagnose MCP issues, or $polygres-cli to monitor an import.
